run_adsorbml: run the AdsorbML pipeline for a given slab and adsorbate using a pretrained ML model
run_adsorb_ml_pipeline: run the ML-based adsorbate-slab relaxation pipeline with energy referencing and anomaly detection
generate_adsorbate_slab_configurations: generate multiple adsorbate-slab configurations from a slab and list of adsorbates
reference_adsorbate_slab_energies: reference adsorbate-slab energies to atomic and slab energies for adsorption energy calculation
detect_adsorbate_anomalies: detect anomalies like dissociation, desorption, surface changes, or intercalation in relaxed structures
